headline: Market Outlook: Market Closes Higher; Here's How It May Move on August 21
summary: Indian markets closed higher after US Treasury intervention curbed the rise in global bond yields. The move weakened the dollar and strengthened the rupee, easing pressure on emerging markets.
why: The US Treasury influences the Treasury market and the dollar, which affect global capital flows into emerging markets such as India. Bond yields set the cost of capital worldwide.
why_moved: US Treasury intervention curbed the rise in global bond yields, which weakened the dollar and strengthened the rupee. Lower yield pressure increased investor interest in emerging markets.
